svg.title: AI Archaeology Mathematical Mandala
svg.desc: A clickable map of 110 equations grouped by the human needs that forced them to exist.

a.title: Open the Mathematical Gist
What kind of thing is this, and how do its pieces stay addressable?
What changed, how far apart are two observations, and what direction survives?
Which contributions belong in one answer, and which relationships must interact?
How do totals become fair shares, averages, or comparable scales?
How can scale change without discarding the relationship we care about?
Which candidate wins, and which possibilities remain allowed?
If this changes slightly, what moves downstream and by how much?
Which possibilities remain alive, and how strongly should each count?

Excavation 002 — Vectors — \mathbf{x}=[x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_n] — moves: brackets, indices, equals

Excavation 005 — Matrices — \text{threat score}=2(4)+3(5)=23 — moves: multiplication, addition, equals
Excavation 005 — Matrices — \text{chase score}=0(4)+4(5)=20 — moves: multiplication, addition, equals
Excavation 007 — A Place for Meaning to Live — \text{token}\longrightarrow \mathbf{e}\in\mathbb{R}^d — moves: arrows, membership, powers
Excavation 009 — From Scores to Attention — \mathrm{softmax}(s_i)=\frac{e^{s_i}}{\sum_j e^{s_j}} — moves: exponential, summation, division
Excavation 010 — Query, Key, and Value — s_{ij}=\mathbf{q}_i\cdot\mathbf{k}_j =\sum_r q_{ir}k_{jr} — moves: dot product, multiplication, summation
Excavation 010 — Query, Key, and Value — \mathbf{o}_i=\sum_j \alpha_{ij}\mathbf{v}_j — moves: dot product, multiplication, summation
Excavation 011 — Multi-Head Attention — \mathrm{MultiHead}(X) =\mathrm{Concat}(\text{head}_1,\ldots,\text{head}_H)W_O — moves: concatenation, multiplication

Excavation 013 — Residual Connections — \mathbf{y}=\mathbf{x}+F(\mathbf{x}) — moves: addition, function application
Excavation 014 — Layer Normalization — \mu=\frac1d\sum_i x_i, — moves: mean, subtraction, variance, square root, division, addition

Excavation 014 — Layer Normalization — \widehat{x}_i=\frac{x_i-\mu}{\sqrt{\sigma^2+\epsilon}} — moves: mean, subtraction, variance, square root, division, addition
Excavation 015 — How a Dead Brain Learns — \theta\leftarrow\theta-\eta\nabla L — moves: gradient, negative sign, multiplication, arrows
Excavation 017 — Probability — Counting What We Do Not Know — P(A)=\frac{\text{times }A\text{ occurred}}{\text{comparable observations}} — moves: division, probability
Excavation 018 — Likelihood — Which Hidden Story Produced This Evidence? — \mathcal{L}(\theta\mid x)=P(x\mid\theta) — moves: conditional bar, equals
Excavation 019 — Information — Why Surprise Needs a Number — I(x)=-\log P(x) — moves: logarithm, negative sign
Excavation 020 — Entropy — Measuring the Uncertainty of a Whole Situation — H(P)=-\sum_i p_i\log p_i — moves: multiplication, summation, logarithm, negative sign
Excavation 021 — Cross-Entropy — Paying for Confidently Wrong Predictions — H(P,Q)=-\sum_i p_i\log q_i — moves: logarithm, multiplication, summation
Excavation 022 — Derivatives — Asking One Weight What It Changed — \frac{dL}{dw}=\lim_{\epsilon\to0}\frac{L(w+\epsilon)-L(w)}{\epsilon} — moves: subtraction, division, limit
Excavation 023 — The Chain Rule — Following One Change Through Many Machines — \frac{dL}{dw}=\frac{dL}{dy}\frac{dy}{dx}\frac{dx}{dw} — moves: derivative, multiplication
Excavation 024 — Backpropagation — Reusing Blame Instead of Recomputing It — \bar{x}=\sum_{y\in children(x)}\bar{y}\frac{\partial y}{\partial x} — moves: partial derivative, multiplication, summation
Excavation 025 — Gradient Descent — Teaching a Tiny Network — \theta_{t+1}=\theta_t-\eta\nabla_\theta L — moves: indices, gradient, negative sign, multiplication

Excavation 028 — Momentum — Remembering Which Way Downhill Persists — v_t=\beta v_{t-1}+g_t — moves: multiplication, addition, negative sign
Excavation 028 — Momentum — Remembering Which Way Downhill Persists — \theta_{t+1}=\theta_t-\eta v_t — moves: multiplication, addition, negative sign
Excavation 029 — Initialization — Where Should Learning Begin? — \mathrm{Var}(w)\approx\frac{1}{n_{\text{in}}} — moves: variance, division, approximation, equals
Excavation 030 — Activation Functions — Why a Network Must Bend — h=\phi(Wx+b) — moves: multiplication, addition, function application
Excavation 031 — Overfitting — When Perfect Memory Pretends to Be Intelligence — \text{generalization gap}=L_{\text{unseen}}-L_{\text{train}} — moves: subtraction
Excavation 032 — Regularization — Making Memorization More Expensive — L_{\text{total}}=L_{\text{data}}+\lambda\lVert\theta\rVert^2 — moves: addition, norm, multiplication
Excavation 033 — Validation — Testing Without Peeking at the Final Exam — D=D_{\text{train}}\cup D_{\text{validation}}\cup D_{\text{test}} — moves: union
Excavation 034 — Generalization — What Should Survive Beyond the Dataset? — R(\theta)=\mathbb{E}_{(x,y)\sim P_{\text{future}}}[L(f_\theta(x),y)] — moves: expectation, function application
Excavation 035 — A Tiny Neural Network — Assemble the Entire Learning Loop — x\to Wx+b\to\phi(\cdot)\to\hat y\to L\to\nabla_\theta L\to\theta^\prime — moves: arrows, gradient

Excavation 036 — Tokenization: What Can a Language Model See? — (a^*,b^*)=\underset{(a,b)}{\text{arg max}} c(a,b) — moves: equals, arg max, symbol decorations

Excavation 037 — Input Embeddings: Giving Tokens Learnable Coordinates — \mathbf{x}_i=\mathbf{e}_iE — moves: membership, indices, multiplication

Excavation 040 — Next-Token Examples — One Sentence Becomes Many Lessons — x=(t_0,\ldots,t_{n-1}) — moves: brackets, indices
Excavation 040 — Next-Token Examples — One Sentence Becomes Many Lessons — y=(t_1,\ldots,t_n) — moves: brackets, indices
Excavation 041 — Logits — Let Every Vocabulary Token Compete — \ell_i=hW_{\text{vocab}}+b — moves: multiplication, addition, indices
Excavation 042 — Vocabulary Probabilities — Turning Scores into a Prediction — p_i=\frac{e^{\ell_i}}{\sum_j e^{\ell_j}} — moves: exponential, summation, division, logarithm, negative sign
Excavation 042 — Vocabulary Probabilities — Turning Scores into a Prediction — L=-\log p_y — moves: exponential, summation, division, logarithm, negative sign

Excavation 053 — Preference Learning — When Several Answers Are Correct but Not Equally Helpful — P(A\succ B)=\frac{1}{1+\exp(-(r_A-r_B))} — moves: subtraction, negative sign, exponential, division

Excavation 158 — Multi-Query Attention — Why Cache Separate Copies for Every Head? — M_{\text{KV}}\propto L H_{\text{KV}} d_h — moves: multiplication, proportionality
Excavation 159 — Grouped-Query Attention — Recover Some Specialist Memory — g(h)=\left\lfloor\frac{hH_{\text{KV}}}{H_Q}\right\rfloor — moves: multiplication, division, rounding
Excavation 160 — FlashAttention — The Arithmetic Was Not the Bottleneck — m^{\prime}=\max(m,\max_j s_j) — moves: maximum, symbol decorations
Excavation 161 — RMSNorm — Do We Need to Subtract the Centre? — \mathrm{RMS}(x)=\sqrt{\frac1d\sum_{i=1}^{d}x_i^2} — moves: powers, summation, division, square root
Excavation 162 — Pre-Normalization — Protect the Residual Highway — x_{\ell+1}=x_\ell+F(\mathrm{RMSNorm}(x_\ell)) — moves: function application, addition
Excavation 163 — SwiGLU — Let One Learned Path Gate Another — \mathrm{SwiGLU}(x)=\mathrm{SiLU}(xW_g)\odot(xW_v) — moves: function application, multiplication
Excavation 164 — Weight Tying — Use One Word Geometry Twice — W_{\text{out}}=E^{\mathsf T} — moves: equals

Excavation 166 — AdamW — Keep Shrinkage Separate from Adaptation — \theta_{t+1}=(1-\eta\lambda)\theta_t-\eta\frac{\widehat m_t}{\sqrt{\widehat v_t}+\epsilon} — moves: multiplication, subtraction

Excavation 168 — Mixed Precision — Stop Storing Every Number with Unneeded Detail — M=\frac{N b}{8}\ \text{bytes} — moves: multiplication, division
Excavation 169 — Loss Scaling — Rescue Gradients Too Small to Represent — g=\frac{1}{S}\nabla_\theta(SL) — moves: multiplication, division
Excavation 170 — Gradient Accumulation — Build a Large Batch That Does Not Fit — g_{\text{effective}}=\frac1K\sum_{k=1}^{K}g_k — moves: summation, division
Excavation 171 — Activation Checkpointing — Remember Less, Recompute Exactly — M_{\text{activations}}=O(\sqrt{L}) — moves: square root, proportionality
Excavation 172 — ZeRO — Stop Replicating the Same Training State — M_{\text{state per device}}\approx\frac{M_{\text{total state}}}{P} — moves: division, approximation
Excavation 173 — Tensor Parallelism — Split One Matrix That No Device Can Hold — Y_p=XW_p,\quad Y=[Y_1,Y_2,\ldots,Y_P] — moves: concatenation, multiplication
Excavation 174 — Speculative Decoding — Let a Small Model Propose, Never Decide — a(x)=\min\left(1,\frac{p(x)}{q(x)}\right) — moves: division, minimum
Excavation 177 — Document Boundaries — Keep One Story from Leaking into Another — A_{ij}=\begin{cases}1&\text{tokens }i,j\text{ share a document}\\0&\text{otherwise}\end{cases} — moves: cases, equals

Excavation 178 — Language Identification — Do Not Confuse Familiar Script with Familiar Language — \ell^*=\underset{\ell\in\mathcal L}{\mathrm{argmax}}\ p(\ell\mid d) — moves: conditional bar, arg max
Excavation 179 — Exact Deduplication — Stop Paying Twice for the Same Document — h(d)=H(N(d)) — moves: function composition, equals
Excavation 180 — Near Deduplication — When a Copy Changes a Few Words — J(A,B)=\frac{\lvert A\cap B\rvert}{\lvert A\cup B\rvert} — moves: intersection, union, cardinality, division
Excavation 184 — Data Mixtures — Decide Which Worlds Receive a Voice — \sum_{d=1}^{D}w_d=1,\quad w_d\ge 0 — moves: summation, equals, inequalities
Excavation 185 — Mixture Sampling — Turn Planned Shares into a Reproducible Stream — E[n_d]=Nw_d — moves: multiplication, expectation
Excavation 186 — The Token Budget — Convert a Training Plan into a Count of Lessons — N_{\text{tokens}}=T B_{\text{tokens}} — moves: multiplication
Excavation 187 — Compute-Optimal Allocation — Buy a Larger Memory or More Experience? — C\approx 6PD — moves: multiplication, approximation

Excavation 188 — Learning-Rate Warmup — Let Adam Learn the Terrain Before Running — \eta_t=\eta_{\text{peak}}\frac{t}{T_{\text{warm}}}\quad(0\le t\le T_{\text{warm}}) — moves: division, multiplication

Excavation 189 — Cosine Decay — Make Late Corrections Smaller Without a Cliff — \eta_t=\eta_{\min}+\frac{\eta_{\max}-\eta_{\min}}{2}\left(1+\cos\frac{\pi t}{T}\right) — moves: subtraction, division, cosine
Excavation 190 — Gradient Noise Scale — When More Examples Stop Buying More Direction — G=\frac{\mathrm{tr}(\mathrm{Cov}[g_i])}{\lVert E[g_i]\rVert^2} — moves: covariance, trace, division
Excavation 191 — Data Parallelism — Let Several Workers Observe Different Evidence — g=\frac1P\sum_{p=1}^{P}g_p — moves: summation, division
Excavation 192 — Pipeline Parallelism — Stop Waiting for the Whole Model to Cross One Device at a Time — U=\frac{m}{m+p-1} — moves: addition, division
Excavation 193 — Three-Dimensional Parallelism — Give Each Memory Wall Its Own Axis — P_{\text{total}}=P_{\text{tensor}}P_{\text{pipeline}}P_{\text{data}} — moves: multiplication, equals
Excavation 196 — Loss Spikes — Distinguish One Hard Batch from a Run Leaving the Road — z_t=\frac{L_t-\mu_t}{\sigma_t} — moves: subtraction, division

Excavation 197 — A Validation Stream — Ask Whether Learning Survives Outside the Current Batch — L_{\text{val}}=-\frac1N\sum_{i=1}^{N}\log p_\theta(x_i\mid x_{<i}) — moves: logarithm, negative sign, summation, division

Excavation 198 — A Memorization Audit — Did the Model Learn a Pattern or Store a Passage? — \mathrm{exposure}=\log_2\lvert\mathcal R\rvert-\log_2\mathrm{rank} — moves: cardinality, logarithm, subtraction
